# onetsolutions_vpc_ip_allocations (Data Source)

Lists the private IP addresses allocated in a VPC, ordered by address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_vpc" "backend" {
  name = "backend"
}

data "onetsolutions_vpc_ip_allocations" "backend" {
  vpc_id = data.onetsolutions_vpc.backend.id
}

# The private address of each instance in the VPC, by instance name.
output "backend_private_ips" {
  value = {
    for a in data.onetsolutions_vpc_ip_allocations.backend.allocations : a.instance_name => a.ip_address
    if a.allocation_type == "instance"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (String) The UUID of the VPC.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `allocations` (Attributes List) The addresses reserved or allocated in the VPC; released ones are not listed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations))

<a id="nestedatt--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations`

Read-Only:

- `allocated_at` (String) When the address was allocated (RFC 3339).
- `allocation_type` (String) `instance` for an instance's address, `gateway` for the VPC's gateway.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the allocation.
- `instance_id` (String) The UUID of the instance using the address, null for the gateway's.
- `instance_name` (String) The name of the instance using the address, null for the gateway's.
- `interface_index` (Number) The private network interface the address is on: `1` for the first.
- `ip_address` (String) The private IPv4 address.
- `status` (String) `reserved` or `allocated`.
